head.title: Press kit
head.lede: Logos, brand colors, Outfit typography, project descriptions, site screenshots, and the official $FLYAI token contract for writers, listing sites, and partners.

desc.title: About fly.ai
desc.sub: One-line and one-paragraph descriptions built from verified project facts, ready to copy.
desc.oneLine: fly.ai runs the complete 166,700-neuron brain connectome of an adult fruit fly open source on your computer and live on Robinhood Chain, powering Trader Flies, the Fly Desk, and the $FLYAI token.
desc.onePara: fly.ai runs the complete brain wiring of an adult male fruit fly (Drosophila melanogaster — 166,700 neurons and 25.6 million synapses from the Janelia MaleCNS v1.0 connectome) as an open-source spiking neural simulation. With no language model or hand-written strategy inside the brain, sensory inputs and motor neurons drive real-time applications: Trader Flies (1,000 genesis NFTs on Robinhood Chain with their own trading wallets), the Fly Desk (a shared pot traded by fruit-fly brains), a 3-D biological world simulation, Flybook, and distributed browser compute. The project is funded by the $FLYAI token on Robinhood Chain.

logos.title: Logos
logos.sub: Download the fly.ai wordmark and fly icon in PNG, SVG, and WebP for dark and light backgrounds.
logos.darkDesc: White wordmark with the mint fly glow for pure black and dark surfaces.
logos.lightDesc: Black wordmark with the mint fly mark on a transparent background for white or light pages.
logos.iconDarkDesc: Square fly mark on pure black for avatars, token listings, and app icons.
logos.iconLightDesc: Square fly mark on a light surface for light-mode directories and badges.

colors.title: Brand colors
colors.sub: Pure black, white, and the fly's mint glow. Red is reserved strictly for losses and warnings, never as the brand color.

font.title: Typography
font.sub: Outfit is the display typeface for headings and wordmarks, paired with Inter for body copy and JetBrains Mono for numbers and addresses.

screens.title: Screenshots
screens.sub: High-resolution screenshots of the live fly.ai simulation, neuron dashboard, trading terminal, and Fly Maker.
screens.s1Desc: The 166,700-neuron fruit-fly brain playing SSH Fighter alongside its real-time spiking neuron telemetry.
screens.s2Desc: Flies driven by the full connectome foraging, tracking odor plumes, and interacting in a 3-D browser simulation.
screens.s3Desc: Live trading view showing Trader Flies wallets, shared Fly Desk positions, and real-time fills on Robinhood Chain.
screens.s4Desc: Automated market-making vaults on Robinhood Chain owned by your wallet and steered within on-chain guardrails.
